REGULATION (EU) 2024/0000 OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT

Whereas this recital precedes the enacting terms and must not be indexed.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

Subject matter

The purpose of this Regulation is to improve the functioning of the internal market.

CHAPTER III

HIGH-RISK AI SYSTEMS

SECTION 1

Classification of AI systems as high-risk

Article 6

Classification rules for high-risk AI systems

1. An AI system shall be considered high-risk where both of the following conditions are fulfilled:

(a)

the AI system is intended to be used as a safety component of a product;

(b)

the product is required to undergo a third-party conformity assessment.

2. In addition to the high-risk AI systems referred to in paragraph 1, AI systems referred to in Annex III shall be considered high-risk.

ANNEX I

This annex content follows the final article and must not be indexed.
